notes.title: Bug Fix : Failed to launch game.
notes.notes:
Warriors of Love, 

We just released an update to fix the following bug: 
- Failed to launch the game on some windows 7 and windows 10 pcs.

If your encounter this issue then please try to launch the game again.
 
For true panty love.

notes.title: Bug fix update!
notes.notes:
We updated the game to fix a bug that occurs when you return to them menu from Arcade which lead to a game crash. We are sorry for the inconvenience caused and you can now enjoy the game smoothly.

Step forward, Warriors of Love, for true love!
